_description: Semantic version manifest for the public context-engine (L1-L2 stack). Tag convention: commits that bump composite_version get tagged context-engine-vX.Y.Z.

L1.name: file-metadata-index
L1.description: Tag-routable file metadata index over a multi-repo vault. Produces monolithic JSON + per-repo slices + manifest.

L2.name: manifest-injection
L2.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that injects the routing manifest before every Claude Code prompt.

version_history.summary: Initial public release. L1 indexer (generate_index.py) + L2 manifest-injection hook. Three-repo example workspace with worked routing traces and tmux automation guide.
